Qualitative analysis revealed that Risk Aversion/Pragmatism was the most frequently occurring theme and was also well distributed across all six outcome choices, thus suggesting that probability-weighing produces morally pluralistic rather than concentrated conclusions.

The paper contributes to existing literature both methodologically and conceptually by demonstrating that apparent moral consensus on outcomes may not exist when multiple options are available to individuals and even when they do, significant disagreement exists on the principles that justify them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过设计名为"双胞胎难题"（Twin Conundrum）的新型道德困境，研究人们在不确定性和不可逆后果威胁下如何做出道德决策。研究发现近半数受访者选择无罪释放双胞胎，表明强烈的道义论偏好，且年龄和政治倾向是显著预测因素。定性分析显示风险规避/实用主义是最常见的主题，表明概率权衡会导致道德多元主义。
AI.research_question: 在信息不对称和不可逆后果威胁下，个体如何做出道德决策？当面对多个跨越不同道德框架的选项时，人们的道德选择呈现何种分布？
AI.motivation: 传统二元选择困境（如电车难题）无法充分捕捉道德决策的复杂性，现实中的道德决策往往面临多个选项且跨越不同道德框架。作者设计了"双胞胎难题"以填补这一方法论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道义论（deontological）、功利主义（utilitarian）、概率论（probabilistic）和报应主义（retributive）等多种道德框架。
AI.method: 两阶段有目的配额抽样方法，确保样本近似全球各大洲人口比例；混合分析框架（定量卡方分析 + 定性主题分析）。
AI.findings: 1. 近半数受访者选择无罪释放双胞胎，表现出强烈的道义论偏好；2. 年龄和政治倾向是显著预测变量——道义论偏好随年龄近似线性增长，左倾受访者更倾向于保护无辜；3. 定性分析显示风险规避/实用主义是最常见且分布最广的主题，表明道德多元主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了当个体面临多个选项时，表面上对结果的道德共识可能并不存在；即使存在共识，在支撑结果的道德原则上也存在显著分歧。
AI.practical_contributions: 为道德心理学研究方法提供了新工具（双胞胎难题），改进了传统二元困境的局限性；揭示了人口统计变量（年龄、政治倾向）对道德决策的系统性影响。

title: A Bayesian Model of Mantra, Persuasion, and Detachment
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: A Bayesian Model of Mantra, Persuasion, and Detachment
detail.abstract: How does one change a belief ? We give a Bayesian account in which a disposition is a heading on the circle carrying a von Mises belief, so that the natural parameter is a planar vector whose direction is what one tends to do and whose length is conviction, and updating is vector addition. A mantra is then repeated pseudo-evidence: each utterance adds a vector, and emotion is the precision it carries. Ramakrishna's maxim, that positive injunction beats prohibition, becomes a theorem. Precision is non-negative, so the updates a mind can perform form a convex cone, the update that would negate a thought points outside it, and the nearest feasible substitute, which must represent what it would suppress, deposits positive evidence on the forbidden direction. A mind cannot subtract a thought. This raises a puzzle, since minds plainly do give up habits. We resolve it with a two-layer model in which outcome beliefs are mapped to behavioral pulls by a value function. Both layers admit only additions, but the value map is order-reversing, so a positive addition in the outcome layer, which is what a story is, produces a strict decrease in the pull of an action. A mind subtracts a direction only by adding a consequence. This is why telling someone not to smoke does nothing while telling them what smoking did to a man they knew does a great deal, and the size of the eect is Hume's likelihood ratio for testimony, damped by entrenchment. Fear is a localized threat belief that avoidance keeps starved of evidence; anxiety is a diuse one, extinguishing more slowly by a factor equal to the number of directions it is smeared across, which is why naming a fear is a precondition for curing it. Recitation is a weak periodic drive, and we show by simulation that its eect on the mind is a stochastic resonance, maximal at an intermediate level of agitation. Simulations conrm the central predictions: an agent told not to go West ends there more often than an agent told nothing, and an injunction against smoking leaves more smokers than silence while a story leaves almost none.

AI.tldr: 本文基于贝叶斯更新和冯·米塞斯分布，提出信念系统是向量加法的数学框架。核心发现：心灵无法直接减法（消除信念），只能通过加法（引入新证据/故事）间接改变行为。禁忌效应（"不要做X"反而增加X行为）被数学证明为必然结果，而故事（叙事）通过价值函数的反向映射实现行为抑制。
AI.research_question: 信念如何改变？特别是，为什么直接的禁令（"不要做X"）无效，而叙事（故事）却能有效改变行为？
AI.motivation: 日常生活中"不要吸烟""不要向西走"等禁令往往适得其反，而故事却能深刻改变行为。这一现象缺乏严格的数学解释。同时，贝叶斯认知模型面临"信念减除"（如何放弃一个习惯）的理论困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 冯·米塞斯分布（von Mises distribution）：信念表示为圆上的方向，自然参数为平面向量（方向=倾向，长度=确信度）。2. 贝叶斯更新=向量加法。3. 两层模型：结果信念层（加法+）→ 价值函数（反向映射）→ 行为拉动层（加法+）。4. 凸锥理论：可行更新构成凸锥，阻止一个想法需要在该方向添加正证据。5. 休谟证词似然比、随机共振（stochastic resonance）。
AI.method: 数学推导（凸锥约束下的最优近似更新）+ 计算机模拟（验证禁忌效应和随机共振）。
AI.findings: 1. 心灵不能做减法（无法直接删除信念），只能通过加法间接改变。2. 禁令"不要做X"相当于在X方向添加正证据，反而增加X行为。3. 故事通过向结果信念层添加证据，经价值函数反向映射，减少行为拉动。4. 恐惧是局部化威胁信念（因回避而缺乏证据）；焦虑是弥散性威胁信念（消退速度慢N倍）。5. 诵念（弱周期驱动力）通过随机共振在中度 agitation 时效果最大。6. 模拟证实：被告知"不要向西"的智能体比未被告知的更常向西；禁令留下更多吸烟者，故事几乎消灭吸烟者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将信念更新严格形式化为向量加法（而非传统贝叶斯的乘法）。2. 从数学上证明了"禁止反效果"（Reactance/Ironic Process Theory）的必然性。3. 提出"两层加法"模型，解决认知科学中长期存在的"信念消除"之谜。4. 为情感（恐惧 vs 焦虑）提供精确的数学区分。5. 将随机共振概念引入信念动力学。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 公共卫生/行为干预：不要发布禁令（"不要吸烟"），而应讲述故事（"吸烟如何伤害了某人"）。2. 心理治疗：命名恐惧（将弥散焦虑局部化）是治愈的前提。3. 说服/教育：重复诵念（recitation）在适度的心理 agitation 水平下最有效。4. 政策沟通：负面禁令适得其反，正面叙事才是改变行为的关键。

title: Simplifying Nature Away? Ex-Ante Evidence on the EFRAG ESRS Cuts from Three Years of European Nature Disclosures *
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department of Finance, University of Zurich, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Zurich

detail.title: Simplifying Nature Away? Ex-Ante Evidence on the EFRAG ESRS Cuts from Three Years of European Nature Disclosures *
detail.abstract: The European Commission adopted revised European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) on 3 July 2026, following EFRAG's December 2025 technical advice. Using the datapoint schedule in that technical advice, which reduces required datapoints, when material, by 61% overall and ESRS E4 biodiversity datapoints by 78%, we assess the nature-related disclosures of STOXX Europe 600 companies over FY2023-FY2025 (801 TNFD and 1,047 ESRS firm-year observations) with a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that extends the ASKNATURE system. Three findings bear on the proposal. First, mandatory reporting delivers: ESRS disclosures carry a specificity premium of +0.13 on the unit scale (p < 0.01) and an enforceability premium of +0.16 (p < 0.01) over voluntary TNFD reporting, and ESRS E1+E2 evidence depth rises from 0.785 to 0.805 (FY2025 partial) with narrowing variance under the CSRD. Second, mandatory reporting has limits: it produces no commitment premium, the roughly 4:1 positive-to-negative sentiment skew in nature-impact reporting survives the mandate, and dual TNFD+ESRS reporters show no disclosure premium over single-framework reporters. Third, under proportional datapoint retention the simplification would erase 57% of observable ESRS evidence depth on average and 78% of E4 biodiversity evidence, collapsing the cross-sector differentiation on which institutional nature-risk screening relies. The improving climate-disclosure trend under the CSRD offers no assurance that biodiversity disclosure would survive the simplified regime. Preserving core quantitative E4 requirements, in particular the E4-5 KPIs and site-level granularity, is necessary to keep European nature reporting from reverting to the voluntary cheap-talk baseline we document.

AI.tldr: 基于欧盟2026年7月修订的ESRS（将数据点减少61%，生物多样性数据点减少78%），本文评估STOXX欧洲600指数公司2023-2025财年的自然相关披露。主要发现：强制性报告（ESRS）比自愿性报告（TNFD）具有更高的具体性和可执行性溢价，但无法产生承诺溢价；按比例保留数据点的简化方案将消除57%的ESRS证据深度和78%的E4生物多样性证据，导致跨行业差异化消失。本文认为保留核心量化E4要求（尤其是E4-5关键绩效指标和场地级颗粒度）是维持欧洲自然报告质量的关键。
AI.research_question: 在ESRS大幅简化数据点要求的背景下，强制性自然披露报告（ESRS）相较于自愿性报告（TNFD）的效果如何？简化方案对生物多样性披露质量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 欧盟2026年7月修订的ESRS大幅减少了数据点要求（总体减少61%，E4生物多样性减少78%），这一简化可能对自然相关披露质量产生未知影响。同时，CSRD（企业可持续发展报告指令）下的强制性报告与TNFD自愿性报告的效果差异亟需实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强制性报告理论（mandatory reporting theory）、自愿披露理论（voluntary disclosure theory）、制度经济学中的可执行性（enforceability）与承诺机制（commitment）
AI.method: 使用检索增强生成（RAG）管道扩展ASKNATURE系统，分析STOXX欧洲600指数公司2023-2025财年的数据（801个TNFD公司-年观测值和1,047个ESRS公司-年观测值），进行披露质量、具体性、可执行性、承诺、情感倾向等维度的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 强制性报告有效：ESRS披露在具体性上比TNFD高0.13（p<0.01），可执行性高0.16（p<0.01）；ESRS E1+E2证据深度从0.785提升至0.805（2025财年部分数据），方差收窄。2. 强制性报告有局限：无承诺溢价；自然影响报告中正面/负面情感偏差约4:1，不受强制影响；双框架报告者无额外溢价。3. 简化方案威胁：按比例保留数据点将消除57%的ESRS证据深度和78%的E4生物多样性证据，导致跨行业分化崩溃，阻碍机构自然风险筛选。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了强制性披露与自愿性披露效果比较的实证证据；揭示了强制性报告在承诺维度上的局限；量化了数据点简化对生物多样性披露质量的潜在破坏性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供ESRS简化方案影响的实证评估；建议保留核心量化E4要求（E4-5关键绩效指标和场地级颗粒度）以维护欧洲自然报告质量；警示气候披露改善趋势不能保证生物多样性披露在简化方案下的幸存。

title: State Tax Exemptions for Tribal Cultural Property
affiliations: University of Alabama - School of Law and University of Tennessee, Knoxville - Winston College of Law

detail.title: State Tax Exemptions for Tribal Cultural Property
detail.abstract: In 2026, the California legislature enacted Assembly Bill (AB) 1485, which exempts from real property transfer taxes certain transactions that return tribal land to tribes. This Essay examines AB 1485 as a model for how state tax policy can further tribal sovereignty by facilitating the return of culturally significant land to federally recognized Indian tribes. This Essay argues that state and local taxes imposed on the transfer of land to tribal governments create practical financial barriers to reacquisition, reinforcing the historic erosion of tribal land and limiting tribes' ability to protect sacred sites and sustain community life. Understanding these tax burdens within the broader legacy of allotment and dispossession, this Essay contends that other states should adopt more durable and inclusive exemptions than AB 1485. By reframing transfer tax exemptions as a state's recognition of inherent tribal sovereignty, and as a modest response to the colonial foundations of state land ownership, this Essay concludes that state tax reform can serve as a meaningful tool for states to participate in rebuilding reservation communities and in strengthening tribal-state relations.

AI.tldr: 本文以加州AB 1485法案为例，探讨州级税收政策如何通过豁免部落土地转让税来促进部落主权和土地归还。
AI.research_question: 州和地方土地转让税如何影响部落土地重新获取？AB 1485法案能否作为州税政策促进部落主权的示范模型？
AI.motivation: 部落土地因历史上分配政策和剥夺行为而大量流失，重新获取土地面临州和地方转让税造成的财务障碍，亟需税收政策改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部落主权理论、殖民土地所有权批判、税收政策与部落自治关系理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究（AB 1485）、历史分析
AI.findings: AB 1485为部落土地归还提供转让税豁免，但存在范围和持久性方面的局限；转让税是部落重新获取土地的实质性财务障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将转让税豁免重新定义为州对固有部落主权的承认，而非恩赐；揭示税收政策与殖民土地制度之间的结构性关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他州提供AB 1485的改进方向（更广泛、更持久的豁免）；提供州税改革作为重建部落社区和改善部落-州关系的实践路径。

title: The Incomplete-Gamma Continuation of Ξ and Γ(2) Mixtures
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Incomplete-Gamma Continuation of Ξ and Γ(2) Mixtures
detail.abstract:
Riemann’s incomplete-gamma continuation of ξ is unfolded, one unit cell [n − 1,n] per theta term, by the Gaussian normalisation ∞ 0 e−πv2e−u dv = 1 2eu/2. Three things follow. Construction (Theorem 15). Each cell kernel Bn is, on u > 0, a scale mixture of Γ(2,λ) densities. Writing the cell as a superposition of e−u−λe−u against a positive density Jn supported in λ ≤ 1 makes its mixing density ρn an alternating series whose terms T(n) k = 1 k! λkJndλ decrease for the single reason that λ ≤ 1; Leibniz then gives 0 < ρn ≤T(n) 0 =1 n − 1 3n2 . Assembling the cells with the amplitudes (πn2)−1/4 yields a positive measure M on [1,∞), a staircase bounded by π−1/4ζ(3 2), constant on each [m,m +1) with an exact value in rational combinations of ζ(3 2),...,ζ(2m + 1 2), tending to 0.75333. Shape 2 is the Steutel–Kristiansen threshold: positivity of the mixing measure alone secures infinite divisibility.
Representation (Theorems 6 and 10). The same shift u → u + log(πn2) that produces the cells produces the arithmetic weights. Writing Λ(s) = π−s/2Γ(s/2)ζ(s) for the completed zeta, so that ξ = 1 2s(s − 1)Λ and the two have the same zeros on the strip, the cells sum to Λ with no polynomial factor at all: −Λ(s) = n(πn2)−s/2Gn(s/2) on 0 < Res < 1, the strip being exactly the joint domain of convergence. On s = 1 2 + z this is a sum of two one-sided transforms of the positive half-kernel D|u>0 at the conjugate arguments 1 4 ± z 2, so that ζ(1 2 + z) = 0 if and only if G(z) + G(−z) = 0. Cellwise the inner factor is a genuine L´evy factor e−ψn with kn ≥ 0; for the assembled kernel it is false: D(u)/u is not completely monotone (Theorem 34), because summing the shifted cells reconstitutes ϑ(eu) and with it a natural boundary at Imu = ±π 2, while complete monotonicity would force analyticity on Reu >0. The Γ(2) structure is a property of one cell and does not survive the arithmetic superposition of translates.
Reciprocal (Lemma 24). The sine-squared transform sends any L´evy representation of a function F, with measure M ≥ 0 and drift b ≥ 0, to a Thorin representation of 1/F(√s) with density U(v) = (2π√v)−1 b+ 2sin2(x√v/2)M(dx) = (2π√v)−1Re(F′/F)(i√v). Section 4 records what the two classical criteria do and do not give: Thorin’s condition excludes off-line zeros, but at the centre its measure is purely atomic, τ δτ2, so the hypothesis is equivalent to the conclusion; and the Hermite–Biehler dominance of P´olya–Cardon, though sufficient, fails numerically for the Riemann kernel. Nothing here bears on the location of the zeros.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将Riemann ξ函数分解为基于高斯归一化的单胞结构，证明了每个单胞核是Γ(2,λ)尺度混合，并建立了完整zeta函数Λ(s)的无多项式级数表示。同时探讨了Lévy表示、Thorin表示与零点条件的关系，但指出该方法不涉及零点位置本身。
AI.research_question: 如何将Riemann ξ函数（及完整zeta函数Λ(s)）通过高斯归一化分解为单位胞结构，并利用该结构分析其无限可除性、Lévy表示及与零点条件的关系。
AI.motivation: 理解Riemann ξ函数的解析结构，尤其是通过概率论中的尺度混合和无限可除性视角，为探索zeta函数零点的性质提供新的分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高斯归一化（Gaussian normalisation）、Gamma分布尺度混合、Leibniz交错级数判别法、Lévy–Khintchine表示、Thorin表示（广义无限可除性）、Hermite–Biehler准则。
AI.method: 将Riemann ξ函数的不完全Gamma延拓按单位区间分解，利用高斯积分归一化构造单胞核Bn；通过尺度混合密度ρn的交错级数表达证明其正性；进一步将单胞叠加为完整zeta函数的级数表示，并检验其Lévy性质和完全单调性。
AI.findings: (1) 每个单胞核Bn在u>0上是Γ(2,λ)的尺度混合，混合密度ρn为正且有上界1/n−1/(3n²)；(2) 完整zeta函数Λ(s)可表示为无多项式因子的级数，在临界带上收敛；(3) 单胞内因子是真正的Lévy因子，但叠加后的核D(u)/u不是完全单调的，因为叠加恢复了ϑ(eu)的自然边界；(4) 正弦平方变换可将Lévy表示转为Thorin表示，但Thorin条件等价于结论，Pólya–Cardon条件数值上不满足Riemann核。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Riemann ξ函数的单胞分解与Gamma尺度混合之间的深层联系；证明了叠加破坏完全单调性的机制（自然边界）；连接了Lévy过程理论与解析数论中的zeta函数表示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为zeta函数的级数表示提供了新的精确构造（无多项式因子）；为使用概率方法（无限可除性、完全单调性）研究解析数论问题提供了分析框架；澄清了某些经典准则（Thorin、Hermite–Biehler）在该问题上的适用边界。

title: The Effectiveness of an Intensive AI Professional Development Program on Primary School Teachers' AI-PCK: The Pivotal Role of Assessment Rubric Design

detail.title: The Effectiveness of an Intensive AI Professional Development Program on Primary School Teachers' AI-PCK: The Pivotal Role of Assessment Rubric Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This sub-study evaluates the effectiveness of an intensive Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) professional development program in enhancing primary school teachers' AI-based Pedagogical Content Knowledge (AI-PCK) and identifies the specific component that yielded the highest level of improvement. Using a quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design, the study examined a sample of 142 in-service primary school teachers. Data were collected via a researcher-developed questionnaire covering 5 distinct components of AI-PCK and analyzed using paired t-tests and Cohen's d effect size. The findings confirmed a highly significant overall positive impact of the professional development program on the teachers' total AI-PCK scores (𝑝 < 0.001), accompanied by an exceptionally large effect size (𝑑 = 3.71). Learning gain analysis revealed that the fifth component-familiarity with and application of assessment rubrics-experienced the most substantial improvement, achieving the highest learning gain (2.65) and the largest individual effect size (𝑑 = 4.82). This result implies that in the era of Generative AI, the critical professional development priority for primary school teachers has shifted from content creation tools toward mastering the design of authentic, process-oriented assessment rubrics. This research offers a foundational framework for educational policymakers addressing the challenge of AI authenticity in primary education.

AI.tldr: 一项准实验研究发现，针对小学教师的生成式AI专业发展项目能显著提升其AI教学法内容知识（AI-PCK），其中第五个组件——评估量规的熟悉与应用——提升最大，表明教师专业发展的重点正从内容创作工具转向过程性评估量规的设计。
AI.research_question: 强化式生成式AI专业发展项目能否有效提升小学教师的AI-PCK？哪个具体组件提升最大？
AI.motivation: 在生成式AI迅速融入教育的背景下，小学教师需要系统性地提升AI教学能力，但目前缺乏针对AI-PCK专业发展项目的有效性评估研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI-PCK（AI Pedagogical Content Knowledge，AI教学法内容知识）框架，包含5个组件。
AI.method: 准实验前测-后测设计，样本为142名在职小学教师，使用研究者自编问卷收集数据，采用配对t检验和Cohen's d效应量分析。
AI.findings: 项目对教师AI-PCK总分有显著正向影响（p < 0.001），效应量极大（d = 3.71）；第五组件（评估量规的熟悉与应用）提升最显著，学习增益2.65，效应量d = 4.82。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了AI-PCK框架在专业发展情境中的有效性，并揭示了各组件对培训的差异化响应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了基础框架，指出在生成式AI时代，小学教师专业发展的优先事项应从内容创作工具转向真实性、过程性评估量规的设计。

title: Why carbon offsets can't be fixed: Economic theory with illustrations from Australia
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Why carbon offsets can't be fixed: Economic theory with illustrations from Australia
detail.abstract: Study after study has found that carbon credit-generating projects have resulted in vastly more carbon being credited as having been abated than has actually been abated. These ‘integrity’ problems are now well-known. In response, scholars have called for improved governance and transparency of carbon credit projects and markets to ensure integrity. We argue that carbon credit markets cannot be fixed, because such markets possess a number of inherent features that conduce to over-crediting and hence low-integrity. Our argument draws primarily on neoclassical economic theory, with a particular focus on the interaction between information and incentive problems that plague carbon credit markets, supplemented by insights from political economy. We illustrate our points using Australia’s carbon credit market, which exhibits the problematic features we identify despite being one of the world’s most highly-regulated carbon credit markets. Our argument supports calls to sever the ‘offset’ relationship between project-based carbon abatement activities and emissions-intensive activities and to adopt separate national carbon accounts, and government strategies, for decarbonisation and carbon removal.

AI.tldr: 本文论证碳信用市场存在固有缺陷，无法通过改进治理和透明度来修复，因为信息与激励问题的相互作用必然导致过度核算碳减排量。以澳大利亚高度监管的碳市场为例，支持切断碳抵消与高排放活动的关联，改为独立的脱碳和碳清除国家账户与战略。
AI.research_question: 碳信用市场能否通过改善治理和透明度来解决其诚信问题（过度核算碳减排量）？
AI.motivation: 已有大量研究发现碳信用项目实际减排量远低于被核算的减排量（诚信问题），学者呼吁加强治理和透明度，但本文认为这些市场存在无法修复的固有缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典经济学理论（聚焦信息与激励问题的相互作用），辅以政治经济学洞见。
AI.method: 理论论证：基于新古典经济学分析碳信用市场的信息与激励问题；案例研究：以澳大利亚高度监管的碳信用市场作为例证。
AI.findings: 碳信用市场存在导致过度核算减排量的固有特征，即使是在全球监管最严格的澳大利亚碳市场中，这些问题仍然存在。因此，碳信用市场无法通过改进治理和透明度来"修复"。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论层面系统论证碳信用市场存在不可修复的固有缺陷，挑战了"通过改善治理可解决诚信问题"的主流观点；揭示了信息问题和激励问题在碳市场中的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议切断基于项目的碳减排活动与高排放活动之间的"抵消"关系；主张采用独立的脱碳和碳清除国家账户及政府战略，为碳市场政策改革提供新方向。

title: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and Corporate Hedging

detail.title: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and Corporate Hedging
detail.abstract: Does mandatory ESG disclosure change how firms hedge? This paper models a firm that jointly chooses hedge ratios and disclosure intensity, with disclosure operating only through the price the firm attaches to residual risk. The model yields closed-form hedge ratios and signed comparative statics, and is tested on Korea's two realized ESG-disclosure mandates (the governance report, phased in by asset tier over 2019-2024, and the environmental-information requirement binding large issuers from 2022) on a 380-firm, 3,420 firm-year panel of KOSPI issuers parsed from OpenDART filings. Group-time ATT estimates are nulls on both hedging margins for both mandates: point estimates within half a percentage point of zero on the primary margin, with confidence intervals that cap a positive response, the sign the competing disclosure channels predict, at one to six percentage points. The channel is risk-specific: mandates that leave market-risk exposure unquantified leave the hedging incentive unchanged. Korea's climate mandate, which compels that quantification from fiscal 2027 with enforcement phasing in through 2030, is the model's dated forward test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了强制性ESG披露是否改变企业的对冲行为。作者建立了一个企业同时选择对冲比率和披露强度的模型，并利用韩国的两项ESG披露强制规定（治理报告和环境信息要求）进行实证检验。结果显示，现有强制披露对企业的对冲行为没有显著影响，但预计2027年生效的气候强制披露（要求量化市场风险敞口）可能会改变这一格局。
AI.research_question: 强制性ESG披露是否以及如何影响企业的对冲（hedging）行为？
AI.motivation: ESG披露强制规定日益普及，但对其经济后果的理解仍不充分。现有文献关于披露如何影响企业风险管理存在竞争性理论预测（如降低信息不对称、改变风险感知等），本文旨在通过理论建模和实证检验厘清这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业联合选择对冲比率和披露强度的理论模型，披露通过影响企业附加在残余风险上的价格（即风险溢价）来发挥作用。
AI.method: 建立封闭解的对冲比率模型并进行比较静态分析；使用韩国KOSPI上市企业380家、3,420个公司-年面板数据，采用分组时间ATT估计（Group-time ATT）进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 两项现有ESG强制披露（治理报告和环境信息要求）对企业的对冲边际均无显著影响，主边际的点估计接近零（半个百分点以内），置信区间上限将正向响应限制在1-6个百分点。但披露渠道具有风险特异性：未量化市场风险敞口的强制披露不会改变对冲激励。韩国气候强制披露（2027财年起要求量化，2030年逐步执行）将成为模型的前瞻性检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了将ESG披露与企业对冲决策联系起来的理论模型，揭示了披露影响对冲的渠道（通过风险溢价而非直接强制要求），并识别了关键条件（风险敞口量化）对披露效果的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了ESG披露设计的重要启示：仅要求披露而不要求量化风险敞口可能不会改变企业的实际风险管理行为；气候风险量化要求可能是改变企业对冲行为的关键因素。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Algorithmic Trading, and Financial Market Microstructure: A Systematic Literature Review
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Algorithmic Trading, and Financial Market Microstructure: A Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: The past two decades have witnessed a structural transformation in financial market microstructure: human traders have been displaced by algorithmic agents operating at microsecond timescales. This paper provides a systematic review of the academic literature on how algorithmic trading (AT), high-frequency trading (HFT), and artificial intelligence—including large language models (LLMs) and machine learning classifiers—have reshaped three foundational dimensions of market quality: liquidity provision, price discovery, and market stability. Following a PRISMA-compliant protocol, we screened 847 initial records across Web of Science, Scopus, SSRN, and Google Scholar, ultimately synthesizing 60 studies meeting pre-specified inclusion criteria. We organize the literature around three central debates. The first concerns whether algorithmic market-making constitutes genuine liquidity supply or phantom liquidity that evaporates under stress, amplifying flash crashes across equity, Treasury, and foreign exchange markets. The second examines the tension between AI-enhanced informational efficiency and systemic fragility induced by algorithmic herding, correlated machine-learning strategies, and retail-driven social media trading. The third surveys the regulatory challenge of detecting AI-facilitated market manipulation—including spoofing and quote stuffing—through natural language processing and high-frequency surveillance. Drawing on foundational contributions from Kyle (1985), Glosten and Milgrom (1985), and Budish, Cramton, and Shim (2015), we characterize the current paradigm as "algorithmic ecology"—a co-evolutionary ecosystem in which AI agents, human traders, exchanges, and regulators continuously adapt to one another's strategies. We identify a fundamental paradigm shift: market microstructure research must transition from models of rational human agents toward frameworks accommodating the strategic behavior, correlated failures, and emergent dynamics of algorithmic agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了算法交易、高频交易和人工智能如何重塑市场流动性、价格发现和市场稳定性三大维度，基于PRISMA方法筛选了60项研究，提出了“算法生态”范式，认为市场微观结构研究需要从理性人模型转向容纳算法代理战略行为和涌现动态的框架。
AI.research_question: 算法交易（AT）、高频交易（HFT）和人工智能（包括大语言模型和机器学习分类器）如何重塑市场质量的三项基本维度：流动性供应、价格发现和市场稳定性？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年金融市场微观结构发生了结构性变革——人类交易者被微秒级算法代理取代，但关于AI对市场质量影响的系统性综述仍然缺乏，尤其是对三个核心争论（算法流动性的真实性、AI效率与系统性脆弱性的张力、AI辅助市场操纵的监管挑战）的综合审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kyle（1985）的做市商模型、Glosten & Milgrom（1985）的信息不对称模型、Budish, Cramton & Shim（2015）的高频交易博弈模型；以及作者提出的"算法生态"（algorithmic ecology）范式——AI代理、人类交易者、交易所和监管者在共同进化生态系统中持续相互适应。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA系统综述协议，检索Web of Science、Scopus、SSRN和Google Scholar，筛选847篇初始记录，最终综合60篇符合预先指定纳入标准的研究。
AI.findings: 识别出三个核心争论：（1）算法做市提供的是真实流动性还是在压力下蒸发的幽灵流动性，加剧股票、国债和外汇市场的闪崩；（2）AI增强的信息效率与算法羊群效应、相关性机器学习策略和零售驱动的社交媒体交易引发的系统性脆弱性之间的张力；（3）通过自然语言处理和高频监控检测AI协助的市场操纵（包括虚假报价和报价填充）的监管挑战。提出市场微观结构研究需要从理性人模型转向容纳算法代理的战略行为、相关性崩溃和涌现动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法生态"（algorithmic ecology）概念，将市场视为AI代理、人类交易者、交易所和监管者共同进化的生态系统；指出理论基础需要从理性人模型转向算法代理的战略行为、相关性崩溃和涌现动态框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构应对AI辅助市场操纵（虚假报价、报价填充）提供系统性依据；为理解闪崩、算法羊群效应和社交媒体驱动的交易风险提供综合视角；指导交易所和市场设计者应对算法时代的市场质量挑战。

title: Maximum Entropy Algorithms for Predictive Rules: Blahut-Arimoto, Conditional Limits, and Iterative Scaling
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Maximum Entropy Algorithms for Predictive Rules: Blahut-Arimoto, Conditional Limits, and Iterative Scaling
detail.abstract: Raking a contingency table, tilting an empirical measure onto a moment condition, allocating scarce attention across states, and quantizing a Gaussian source are four descriptions of one operation: project a baseline distribution onto a convex constraint set in relative entropy. The solution is always an exponential tilt, that tilt is always the gradient of a log-partition function, and that log-partition is always an envelope. We show that the algorithm computing it is determined by exactly two questions. Is the baseline fixed or self-consistent? Are the constraints equalities or inequalities? The answers give iterative proportional fitting, Dykstra-Bregman, Blahut-Arimoto, and majorisation, each a special case of Csiszár-Tusnády alternating minimisation. We work two canonical applications in full, the lottery problem of Stern and Cover (1989) and the rational inattention model of Sims (2003), and show that the rational inattention literature has been running Blahut-Arimoto without naming it. Two warnings emerge. Cyclic I-projection, correct on affine sets, fails silently on inequalityconstrained ones, overstating the divergence by 40% in our example. And the Hessian of mutual information with respect to a parameter is not positive semidefinite, so identification diagnostics built on it are ill-posed; the envelope representation of Polson and Scott repairs this and supplies a free certificate of weak identification.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了四种看似不同的问题（列联表拟合、矩条件倾斜、注意力分配、高斯量化）在数学上等价于将基线分布向凸约束集进行相对熵投影，其解总是指数倾斜，且算法取决于基线是否自洽和约束是等式还是不等式。文章证明了迭代比例拟合、Dykstra-Bregman、Blahut-Arimoto和Majorisation都是Csiszár-Tusnády交替最小化的特例，并给出了两个典型应用（彩票问题和理性不注意模型），同时指出循环I-投影在不平等约束下失效（发散高估40%），以及互信息Hessian不正定导致识别诊断不适定，而Polson-Scott的包络表示可修复这一问题。
AI.research_question: 如何统一理解四种不同领域问题的数学结构，并揭示其算法与几何本质？
AI.motivation: 作者发现列联表拟合、经验测度倾斜、注意力分配和高斯量化在形式上高度相似，但分属不同学科，缺乏统一的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对熵投影、指数倾斜族、Csiszár-Tusnády交替最小化、对偶性（包络函数与对数配分函数的梯度关系）
AI.method: 通过四个问题的等价性证明，分类讨论基线是否自洽与约束是否为等式，统一算法框架，并结合两个应用案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) 所有四种问题均可归结为相对熵投影；2) 算法由两个问题决定（基线自洽性、约束类型）；3) 经典算法（IPF、DB、BA、Majorisation）均为Csiszár-Tusnády特例；4) 理性不注意模型实为未命名的Blahut-Arimoto；5) 循环I-投影在不平等约束下失效；6) 互信息Hessian不正定，包络表示补救识别诊断。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了相对熵投影的统一理论框架，揭示了四种经典算法的深层联系，修正了现有文献中关于循环I-投影和互信息Hessian的错误认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应用领域（如理性不注意模型）提供了正确的算法选择指导，给出了识别诊断的可行方案（Polson-Scott包络表示），并警示了算法误用的具体后果（40%的发散高估）。

title: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
affiliations: Harvard University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
detail.abstract: Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for price-setting: firms' forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forwardlooking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国企业调查数据研究企业对自身边际成本的预测（定价的原始信念），发现这些预测与CPI预期脱节、对当前和过去成本存在系统性的过度反应，且对总体冲击反应不足。在经验现实的成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更陡峭且更缺乏前瞻性：供给冲击因快速影响成本而更具通胀性，需求冲击因企业未能预期未来工资压力而通胀效应减弱，前瞻指引在长期效果减弱但在短期增强。
AI.research_question: 企业如何形成对其自身边际成本的预测？这些原始信念如何影响价格设定及宏观经济的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 现有新凯恩斯模型通常假设企业具有理性预期，但现实中企业的成本预测行为可能与理性预期假设存在系统性偏差，这种偏差对理解通胀动态和货币政策传导具有重要含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线；成本预测的原始信念；理性预期 vs. 经验性成本信念。
AI.method: 使用美国企业调查数据，对企业的边际成本预测进行实证分析，并将其嵌入新凯恩斯模型进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: （1）企业的边际成本预测与CPI预期脱节；（2）对当前和过去成本存在系统性的过度反应；（3）对总体冲击（如总需求变化）反应不足，直到成本实际发生变化；（4）在经验性成本信念下，NKPC更陡峭且更缺乏前瞻性；（5）供给冲击更具通胀性，需求冲击通胀效应减弱；（6）前瞻指引在长期效果减弱但短期效果增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业的原始成本信念（而非通胀预期）引入宏观模型，修正了新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线的结构性参数，为理解通胀的"前瞻性"程度提供了微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行和决策者具有重要启示：供给冲击（如能源价格）会更快传导至通胀，需求管理政策对通胀的影响可能弱于标准模型预测，前瞻指引的时域效应需要重新评估。

title: The Regulatory Waterbed Unilateral Leverage Caps and the Contamination of a Shared Perpetual-Futures Settlement Index

detail.title: The Regulatory Waterbed Unilateral Leverage Caps and the Contamination of a Shared Perpetual-Futures Settlement Index
detail.abstract: A unilateral leverage cap on perpetual-futures contracts that are cash-settled against a shared, manipulable index can raise systemic fragility while lowering total leverage and fire-sale risk. Tightening pushes leverage to opaque offshore venues, where it degrades the shared settlement price. The harm falls on onshore positions that never moved yet settle against that price. In a 2026 calibration, tightening cuts total leverage 11% and raises index contamination 22%. Risk climbs as leverage falls. Regulatory-arbitrage and macroprudential reasoning miss this referenceprice externality. No single cap can address it. The remedy is a Tinbergen pair of instruments. Clean the index, then coordinate margins.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，对永续合约的单边杠杆限制反而会加剧系统脆弱性：虽然总杠杆下降11%，但因杠杆转移至离岸场所导致参考价格被污染22%，系统性风险反而上升。传统监管套利和宏观审慎分析忽略了这种"参考价格外部性"，解决方案是"双管齐下"：先清理指数本身，再协调保证金要求。
AI.research_question: 对永续合约实施单边杠杆上限是降低还是可能加剧系统性风险？"参考价格外部性"机制如何运作？
AI.motivation: 现有监管框架（监管套利视角和宏观审慎视角）忽略了杠杆限制通过污染共享结算价格产生负外部性的机制，需要揭示这一盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参考价格外部性（Reference-Price Externality）：杠杆被压至离岸场所后，这些场所的交易会污染现货指数（共享结算价格），从而伤害未移出的在岸头寸。
AI.method: 理论模型 + 2026年校准模拟。
AI.findings: （1）收紧杠杆上限使总杠杆下降11%；（2）但导致参考价格污染（index contamination）上升22%；（3）杠杆下降时风险反而上升；（4）单一杠杆上限无法解决该问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"参考价格外部性"概念，揭示杠杆监管通过价格传导渠道产生跨域风险溢出，拓展了金融监管套利和宏观审慎理论的分析边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出丁伯根双工具方案：先清理指数（去污染），再协调保证金要求，为跨境加密资产监管提供操作路径。

title: Beyond Enforcement: The Hybrid Advertising Recovery Model (HARM) as a Solution to Deadweight Loss in Digital Goods Markets

detail.title: Beyond Enforcement: The Hybrid Advertising Recovery Model (HARM) as a Solution to Deadweight Loss in Digital Goods Markets

declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: The traditional digital economy operates on a binary licensing model: users are either compliant payers or non-compliant "pirates." This rigidity creates a deadweight loss estimated at $47.5 billion annually, where potential economic value is excluded due to pricing barriers in emerging markets. This paper proposes the Hybrid Advertising Recovery Model (HARM), a framework utilizing third-degree price discrimination to monetize non-compliant users. By substituting currency with "attention friction" (advertising impressions) and "input latency" (performance degradation), firms can recover revenue from zero-marginal-cost goods without cannibalizing premium markets. Case studies of Adobe Systems, Tencent Interactive Entertainment, Sony Interactive Entertainment, and Microsoft Corporation demonstrate the model's efficacy in converting shadow economies into legitimate, measurable asset classes. The paper further argues that the strategic value of HARM extends beyond immediate revenue to the capture of "Behavioral Sovereignty Data" from the Global South-diverse workflow data currently invisible to AI training pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合广告恢复模型（HARM），通过三级价格歧视将非合规用户（盗版者）转化为可 monetize 的用户，用注意力摩擦和输入延迟替代货币支付，在不侵蚀 premium 市场的前提下从零边际成本商品中回收收入。
AI.research_question: 如何通过价格歧视机制将数字经济中的非合规用户（盗版者）转化为可 monetize 的合法用户，从而减少因定价壁垒导致的福利损失？
AI.motivation: 传统数字经济的二元许可模式（合规付费 vs. 盗版）造成每年约475亿美元的福利损失，新兴市场的定价壁垒排除了大量潜在经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三级价格歧视理论、注意力经济学（注意力摩擦代替货币）、输入延迟（性能降级）作为非货币化支付机制。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析Adobe Systems、腾讯互动娱乐、索尼互动娱乐、微软四家公司的实践。
AI.findings: HARM模型能有效将影子经济转化为合法的可计量资产类别，并从全球南方获取AI训练管线中缺失的多样化工作流数据（行为主权数据）。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了价格歧视理论在数字零边际成本商品中的应用边界，提出了"注意力摩擦"和"输入延迟"作为非货币化支付手段的理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了一种在不损害高端市场的前提下，将盗版用户转化为收入来源的实操框架，并揭示了从全球南方获取AI训练数据的战略价值。

title: The General Framework of AI Economics: Computation, Data, and the Limits of Formalized Intelligence
affiliations: Tsinghua University and

detail.title: The General Framework of AI Economics: Computation, Data, and the Limits of Formalized Intelligence
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the first general-purpose technology automating cognitive labor—the core of human productivity—but existing economic frameworks fail to explain its unique cost structure, extreme scale economies, and fundamental physical/logical limits. This paper develops a unified theory of AI economics grounded in computability theory and the ontological distinction between formalized computational systems and human consciousness. We propose a six-factor framework partitioning AI into two incommensurable layers: a formalized layer (compute, algorithms, data, parameters, energy) bound by Turing computability and thermodynamics, and a hyper-Turing layer (human consciousness) as the sole source of paradigm shifts. We make three core contributions: (1) formalize the training-inference cost migration theory, deriving the natural monopoly property of foundation models; (2) reinterpret scaling laws as production functions incorporating consciousness as a non-substitutable factor, explaining the AI productivity paradox; (3) prove three unbreakable "cages" constraining all AI systems, demonstrating consciousness as the irreducible source of value creation. Our framework explains key AI economic phenomena including platform monopolies, limits to AI self-evolution, and the tiered structure of token markets. We further develop a downstream value-augmentation theory of token pricing, demonstrating that token value is anchored by downstream industrial productivity gains rather than production costs, and that quality thresholds create discontinuous price gaps between frontier and commodity tokens. We conclude with testable empirical implications and targeted policy recommendations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于可计算性理论与意识本体论区分，提出AI经济学的统一理论框架，将AI划分为形式化层（受限于图灵可计算性与热力学）和超图灵层（人类意识），系统解释了AI独特的成本结构、极端规模经济及其物理/逻辑极限，并推导出训练-推理成本迁移理论、重释规模定律、证明三重"牢笼"约束，以及提出基于下游价值增值的代币定价理论。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够解释AI独特成本结构、极端规模经济及其物理/逻辑极限的统一经济学理论？
AI.motivation: 现有经济框架无法解释AI作为首个自动化认知劳动（人类生产力核心）的通用目的技术所具有的独特成本结构、极端规模经济效应以及根本性的物理/逻辑极限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可计算性理论（Turing computability）与本体论区分（形式化计算系统 vs 人类意识）的六因素框架，将AI分为形式化层（计算、算法、数据、参数、能量）和超图灵层（人类意识）。
AI.method: 理论推导：基于可计算性理论、热力学定律和意识哲学进行形式化建模，推导训练-推理成本迁移理论，重估规模定律作为包含意识这一不可替代因素的生产函数，并证明制约AI系统的三个"牢笼"。
AI.findings: (1) 训练-推理成本迁移使得基础模型具有自然垄断属性；(2) 规模定律应被重新解释为包含意识作为不可替代因素的生产函数，解释了AI生产率悖论；(3) 证明了三重不可打破的"牢笼"约束，表明意识是价值创造的不可约来源；(4) 代币价值由下游工业生产率提升锚定而非生产成本，质量阈值导致前沿代币与商品代币之间存在非连续价格差距。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 形式化了训练-推理成本迁移理论，推导出基础模型的自然垄断性质；(2) 重新解释规模定律为包含意识作为不可替代因素的生产函数；(3) 证明了制约所有AI系统的三个不可打破的"牢笼"，论证意识是价值创造的不可约来源；(4) 提出了下游价值增值的代币定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 解释了AI经济中的关键现象，包括平台垄断、AI自演化极限和代币市场的层级结构；(2) 提供了可检验的实证含义和针对性的政策建议。

title: Private Entity, Public Perks: Examining the Accountability of the BCCI as a Registered Society in Light of Subsidised Public Land and State Support
affiliations: Quantum University

detail.title: Private Entity, Public Perks: Examining the Accountability of the BCCI as a Registered Society in Light of Subsidised Public Land and State Support
detail.abstract:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), registered as a society under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975, occupies a paradoxical position in Indian law and governance. It is the world's wealthiest cricket board, wielding monopolistic control over the sport that functions as India's de facto national pastime, yet it claims the legal identity of a private, autonomous organisation beyond the reach of public accountability laws. This paper examines the tension between that private claim and the substantial public benefits the BCCI enjoys, including subsidised government land at nominal lease rates, tax exemptions under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, deployment of state police and administrative machinery, and the tacit backing of both the Central Government and state governments.

The central argument of this paper is that the BCCI's enjoyment of significant public resources — quantified in indirect terms at over Rs 2,100 crore in tax exemptions alone between 1997 and 2007[1] — combined with its exercise of functions of national importance, creates a compelling legal and constitutional case for treating it as a 'public authority' subject to transparency obligations. The paper employs doctrinal legal research, drawing on primary sources including Supreme Court judgments, Law Commission reports, Parliamentary debates, and Central Information Commission (CIC) orders.

The principal findings are: first, that the Supreme Court has recognised BCCI as performing 'public functions' amenable to writ jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution, even while declining to classify it as 'State' under Article 12; second, that the Law Commission's 275th Report (2018) and the CIC's 2018 order supported RTI applicability, a conclusion reversed by the CIC in 2026; and third, that the National Sports Governance Act, 2025, by limiting RTI applicability to bodies receiving direct government grants, has created a policy gap that shields the BCCI from meaningful accountability. The paper recommends a hybrid regulatory model that conditions public benefits on conditional transparency obligations, alongside targeted legislative reform to the RTI Act, 2005.


 


[1]Law Commission of India, 275th Report: 'Legal Framework: BCCI vis-a-vis Right to Information Act' (April 2018) [hereinafter 'LCI 275th Report'] 3-5.

AI.tldr: 本文论证印度板球管理委员会（BCCI）虽声称是私人自治组织，但因享受大量公共资源（如税收减免超2100亿卢比、政府补贴土地等）并行使国家重要职能，应被视为"公共机构"而受透明度义务约束。文章通过教义法学研究，分析了最高法院、法律委员会和中央信息委员会的裁决，指出当前法律存在政策漏洞，并提出混合监管模式与立法改革建议。
AI.research_question: 印度板球管理委员会（BCCI）在享受大量公共资源并行使国家重要职能的情况下，是否应在法律上被认定为"公共机构"，从而受到透明度义务（如《信息权法》）的约束？
AI.motivation: BCCI声称是私人自治组织以规避公共问责法律，但其享受着政府补贴土地、税收豁免、国家警察和行政资源等实质性公共利益，这种"私人身份-公共利益"的悖论引发了 accountability 赤字，亟待法律澄清与制度回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共职能理论（public functions test）、国家行为理论（State under Article 12 vs. Article 226 writ jurisdiction）、透明度与问责制原则、混合监管模型（hybrid regulatory model）。
AI.method: 教义法学研究（doctrinal legal research），主要法律来源包括：印度最高法院判决、法律委员会报告、议会辩论记录、中央信息委员会（CIC）命令。
AI.findings: 第一，最高法院认定BCCI行使"公共职能"因而受《宪法》第226条令状管辖，但未将其归为第12条下的"国家"；第二，法律委员会第275号报告（2018年）和CIC 2018年命令支持RTI适用，但CIC于2026年推翻了该结论；第三，《2025年国家体育治理法》限定只有直接接受政府资助的机构才适用RTI，造成政策漏洞，使BCCI免于实质性问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"公共利益受益者"与"公共职能行使者"双重标准作为认定公共机构的理论依据；揭示了"国家"（Article 12）与"公共机构"（RTI框架）之间的法律灰色地带，丰富了公共问责理论在体育治理领域的适用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立混合监管模式：将公共利益的享受与透明度义务挂钩（conditional transparency obligations）；提出对《2005年信息权法》进行针对性立法改革，填补因《2025年国家体育治理法》造成的政策空白，为BCCI及类似组织建立问责机制。

title: Can LLMs Hire Fairly? Racial Bias in Resume Screening
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School,  and

detail.title: Can LLMs Hire Fairly? Racial Bias in Resume Screening
detail.abstract: We audit fourteen mainstream large language models (LLMs) for hiring discrimination using the paired-resume methodology of Kline, Rose, and Walters (2022). The sole 2023-vintage model reproduces the pro-White callback gap documented in field experiments on labor market discrimination (+2.12 pp, significant at the 1% level). Every model released in 2024 or after shows either a null gap or a significant pro-Black reversal (up to-3.01 pp). The same pattern holds on the gender axis. Based on 24,024 paired postings per model across 14 models, our results document a reversal in the direction of algorithmic hiring bias across model generations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过配对简历方法审计了14个主流大语言模型在招聘中的歧视偏差，发现2023年模型再现了白人优势（+2.12百分点），而2024年后发布的模型要么无显著差异，要么反而偏向黑人（最高-3.01百分点），且性别维度呈现相同模式。研究揭示了算法招聘偏差在模型代际间的逆转现象。
AI.research_question: 不同代际的大型语言模型在招聘决策中是否存在种族和性别歧视偏差？偏差的方向和程度是否随模型更新而变化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注人类招聘歧视，且已有文献发现早期AI模型可能复制人类偏见。但新一代模型是否仍然存在相同方向的歧视，或者模型更新是否改变了偏差方向，尚缺乏系统性的跨代际审计研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论、算法公平性理论、模型代际偏差演化理论
AI.method: 采用Kline, Rose和Walters (2022)的配对简历法，对14个主流大语言模型进行审计，每个模型进行24,024次配对发布，共积累336,336个观测值，比较2023年与2024年后模型在种族和性别维度上的回调差异。
AI.findings: 2023年模型存在显著的白人优势回调差距（+2.12个百分点，1%显著水平）；2024年及以后发布的所有模型要么呈现无显著差异，要么出现显著的黑人优势逆转（最高-3.01个百分点）；性别维度呈现相同模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了大型语言模型代际间招聘偏差方向的逆转现象，拓展了算法公平性理论对模型更新影响的认知，为理解AI系统社会偏见的时间动态性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供LLM招聘工具偏差的跨代际实证证据，提示需根据模型版本制定差异化的公平性审核策略，并关注偏差方向逆转可能带来的新型不公平问题。

title: A Mortality-Adjusted Discount Rate for Intangible Asset Valuation: Theoretical Derivation, Sector Calibration, and Preliminary Empirical Evidence

detail.title: A Mortality-Adjusted Discount Rate for Intangible Asset Valuation: Theoretical Derivation, Sector Calibration, and Preliminary Empirical Evidence
detail.abstract: Every conventional discount rate used in intangible asset valuation - WACC, levered cost of equity (Ke), and unlevered cost of equity (Ku) - is derived from observable equity prices of firms that carry debt. Even Ku, the theoretically cleanest of the three, is estimated by unlevering the Ke of comparable companies, thereby importing their capital structures into the asset-level rate. This paper proposes Ko, a mortality adjusted operational discount rate derived entirely from risk-free rates, market risk premia, and empirically calibrated sector survival curves - with substantially reduced dependence on capital structure: the mortality premium πmort and the risk-free rate Rf require no leverage data, while the systematic component βu×ERP retains a residual dependence on sector comparables’ leverage via standard unlevering. Ko is formally derived as Ko = Rf + βu × ERP + πmort, where πmort = −ln[S(T+H)/S(T)]/H is the conditional mortality premium, S(t) is the Weibull survival function calibrated from establishment cohort data, T is the firm's age at valuation, and H is the asset's useful life horizon. We calibrate Ko across 19 NAICS sectors using 30 years of U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics cohort data. Cross-sectoral mortality premia range from 0.21% (Healthcare) to 21.49% (Transportation and Warehousing), producing Ko values between 7.40% and 28.68% against a sector-average Ku of 7.19%. The differential in intangible asset value between Ko and Ku ranges from 0.9% to 53.9% depending on sector mortality profile and firm age. These figures apply to assets with full operational continuity dependence (transferability factor φ=1); for separable assets such as patents and registered trademarks, the effective mortality premium scales as φ×πmort where φ∈[0,1]. Illustrative application to the NovaDerm Therapeutics LLC case (NAICS 325620) demonstrates that Ko converges within 1.73 percentage points of the Duff & Phelps build-up rate - achieved through a structurally independent derivation that requires no leverage assumption, no comparable company selection. The systematic risk component retains a residual dependence on sector comparables via standard unlevering, acknowledged in Section 2.1. Ko operationalizes the survival-conditioned discounting established by Skogsvik (2006) and Damodaran’s truncation-risk analysis, extending it to the intangible-asset PPA level with a sector-cohort calibration and a transferability adjustment. Ko separates and makes observable the capital structure contamination identified in purchase price allocation practice under IFRS 3 and ASC 805. Ko further provides a tractable, auditable rate for intangible asset valuation in M&A contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的无形资产折现率Ko，它由无风险利率、市场风险溢价和行业生存曲线计算得出，大幅降低了对资本结构的依赖，能够更干净地反映无形资产面临的操作性风险。
AI.research_question: 如何在无形资产估值中构建一个减少资本结构依赖、更准确反映运营风险的折现率？
AI.motivation: 传统折现率（WACC、Ke、Ku）均依赖于可比公司的股权价格和资本结构，在无形资产估值中引入了资本结构"污染"，导致估值偏差。需要一个更干净的、基于运营风险的折现率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Skogsvik (2006)的生存条件贴现理论；2. Damodaran的截断风险分析；3. Weibull生存函数；4. 死亡率溢价（mortality premium）概念。
AI.method: 推导Ko = Rf + βu × ERP + πmort，其中πmort基于美国劳工统计局30年行业队列数据的Weibull生存函数校准得出。覆盖19个NAICS行业，并引入可转移性因子φ∈[0,1]来调整不同资产类型。
AI.findings: 行业死亡率溢价范围0.21%（医疗）至21.49%（运输仓储），Ko值介于7.40%至28.68%（行业平均Ku为7.19%）。与Ku相比的无形资产价值差异在0.9%至53.9%之间。对NovaDerm案例的应用显示Ko与Duff & Phelps构建法差异仅1.73个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生存条件贴现和截断风险分析系统化地扩展到无形资产购买价格分摊（PPA）层面；2. 分离并使资本结构"污染"变得可观察；3. 提供了可审计的折现率构建框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为IFRS 3和ASC 805下的购买价格分摊提供了更干净的折现率；2. 无需可比公司选择和杠杆假设，提高了估值可操作性；3. 适用于并购情境下的无形资产估值。

title: Deep Learning Architectures for Multi-Asset ETF Return Prediction and Portfolio Allocation: MLP, CNN-GAF, LSTM, GRU, and Ensemble Methods
affiliations: , University of Hafr AlBatin and ECOVIS Saudi Arabia (ECOVIS AL SABTI)

detail.title: Deep Learning Architectures for Multi-Asset ETF Return Prediction and Portfolio Allocation: MLP, CNN-GAF, LSTM, GRU, and Ensemble Methods
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the comparative predictive performance of five deep learning architectures-Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Convolutional Neural Network with Gramian Angular Field encoding (CNN-GAF), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and an MLP-LSTM ensemble-applied to 25-day-ahead cumulative log-return prediction across three exchange-traded funds (SPY, TLT, GLD) spanning 2008-2022. Using a 15-dimensional feature vector comprising five technical indicators over an optimal three-day lag window identified through time-series cross-validation, we find that no architecture achieves consistently positive out-of-sample R 2 , consistent with the Efficient Market Hypothesis. However, directional accuracy exceeds the 50% random baseline for all models on equity and fixed-income ETFs. The GRU architecture delivers the highest overall directional accuracy (65.45% for SPY), outperforming LSTM on all metrics. CNN-GAF achieves the best single-asset directional accuracy (67.07% for SPY) by capturing angular momentum patterns in compact 3 × 3 Gramian Angular Summation Field images. A backtested portfolio strategy employing GRU predictions with proportional position sizing generates a total return of +59.29% and a Sharpe ratio of 0.683 over the test period (2018-2022), substantially outperforming an equal-weight buy-and-hold benchmark (+21.48%, Sharpe 0.457) while maintaining a lower maximum drawdown (-22.09% vs.-22.78%). These results demonstrate that GRU-based directional signals with return-magnitude-proportional position sizing offer a tractable and robust framework for short-horizon multi-asset allocation.

title: Strategy in Modern Firms: A Leadership Approach

detail.title: Strategy in Modern Firms: A Leadership Approach
detail.abstract:
In this Document, the situation of a Company, fictitiously named “Hydrogen” and operating in the 
hydroelectric production sector, is represented. 
The following paragraphs describe the strategic peculiarities in terms of company needs and of an 
employee, representing his development situation in the context of insertion and with reference to 
the inter and intra company strategies undertaken.

AI.tldr: 本文以虚构的“Hydrogen”水电公司为例，分析了公司在战略需求与员工发展之间的互动关系，特别是员工在入职融入背景下的发展情况，并参照公司内外战略进行探讨。
AI.research_question: 水电公司在战略需求与员工融入发展之间如何协调？公司内部与外部战略如何影响员工职业发展？
AI.motivation: 通过个案研究揭示企业在战略部署中如何兼顾员工个人发展，尤其是在新员工融入过程中的挑战与策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业战略管理理论、员工组织社会化理论、内部与外部战略协调理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以虚构的Hydrogen公司为对象进行情景分析与描述。
AI.findings: 公司战略与员工发展之间存在相互影响关系；员工融入过程受公司内外部战略的共同作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了企业战略与员工发展交叉领域的案例研究，为组织社会化与战略协同提供了具体情境证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水电行业及其他类似企业在制定战略时如何兼顾员工融入与发展提供了参考。

title: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Harvard University

detail.title: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
detail.abstract: Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for price-setting: firms' forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forwardlooking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国企业调查数据研究企业定价时的原始信念——企业对自身边际成本的预测。研究发现这些预测与CPI预期脱节，系统性地（过度）反应于当前和过去的成本，且对总冲击反应不足，直到成本发生变化。在经验现实的企业成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更陡峭且更缺乏前瞻性。供给冲击因快速传导至成本而更具通胀性；需求冲击因企业未能预见未来工资压力而通胀效应较弱；前瞻性指引在长期效果减弱但在短期效果增强。
AI.research_question: 企业的边际成本预测（定价的原始信念）有何特征？这些特征如何影响新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线的形态以及不同冲击（供给冲击、需求冲击、前瞻性指引）的通胀效应？
AI.motivation: 传统新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线假设企业具有理性预期，但现实中企业的成本信念可能与理性预期存在系统性偏差。理解企业真实的成本预期特征对于准确评估货币政策的传导机制和不同经济冲击的通胀效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）；企业成本信念；理性预期偏差；供给冲击与需求冲击传导机制；前瞻性指引理论。
AI.method: 基于美国企业调查数据，对企业边际成本预测进行实证分析，识别其偏离理性预期的系统性特征；然后将这些经验特征嵌入新凯恩斯模型中，模拟分析不同冲击下的通胀动态。
AI.findings: 1) 企业成本预测与CPI预期脱节；2) 对当前和过去成本存在系统性（过度）反应；3) 对总冲击反应不足，直到成本实际变化；4) 在经验成本信念下，NKPC更陡峭且更缺乏前瞻性；5) 供给冲击更具通胀性（因快速传导至成本）；6) 需求冲击通胀效应更弱（因企业未能预见未来工资压力）；7) 前瞻性指引在长期效果减弱，在短期效果增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业成本信念的实证特征纳入新凯恩斯框架，修正了理性预期假设，揭示了企业非理性预期如何改变菲利普斯曲线形态和冲击传导机制，为理解通胀动态提供了微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行货币政策制定具有重要启示：供给冲击（如能源价格上涨）可能比模型预测的更具通胀性；需求刺激政策可能比预期更弱地推高通胀；前瞻性指引的效力在短期和长期存在非对称性，央行需据此调整沟通策略。

title: Credit Composition, Equity Market Performance, and Crash Risk
affiliations: , Florida International University (FIU) and Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Credit Composition, Equity Market Performance, and Crash Risk

contentType.other: Submitted to Journal of Money, Credit and Banking

detail.abstract: This paper studies how household and business credit expansions differentially affect equity market performance. We show that the composition of private credit is central for asset pricing and financial stability. Expansions in household credit predict lower subsequent stock market returns and a higher probability of market crashes, whereas business credit expansions also forecast lower returns but are not associated with elevated crash risk. These patterns suggest that household credit booms are linked to mispricing and heightened downside tail risk, while business credit booms primarily reflect cyclical variation in investment opportunities and expected risk premia. We further document that these effects vary systematically across countries: the crashrisk implications of household credit are concentrated in advanced economies, while credit expansions in emerging markets primarily operate through business credit with weaker links to crash risk. Finally, we show that the relationship between credit expansions and crash risk depends on the macroprudential policy environment, with policy interventions weakening the adverse effects of household credit growth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了家庭信贷扩张和企业信贷扩张对股票市场表现的不同影响，发现家庭信贷扩张预测更低的股市回报和更高的崩盘风险，而企业信贷扩张虽预测低回报但不伴随崩盘风险。这些效应在发达经济体和新兴市场之间存在差异，且宏观审慎政策可以削弱家庭信贷的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 家庭信贷扩张与企业信贷扩张如何对股票市场回报和崩盘风险产生差异化影响？这种影响在不同经济体和宏观审慎政策环境下是否有所不同？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注私人信贷总量与资产价格的关系，但忽视了信贷结构（家庭信贷 vs 企业信贷）的差异。本文旨在揭示信贷构成对股市定价和金融稳定性的核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭信贷繁荣与错误定价（mispricing）和下行尾部风险（downside tail risk）相关；企业信贷繁荣主要反映投资机会和预期风险溢价的周期性变化。资产定价理论、金融稳定性理论。
AI.method: 跨国面板数据分析，区分家庭信贷与企业信贷扩张，预测未来股市回报和崩盘概率，并进行国别分组与政策环境异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1）家庭信贷扩张预测更低股市回报和更高崩盘风险；2）企业信贷扩张预测更低回报但不增加崩盘风险；3）家庭信贷的崩盘风险效应集中于发达经济体；4）新兴市场信贷扩张主要通过企业信贷渠道，与崩盘风险关联弱；5）宏观审慎政策可削弱家庭信贷的负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了家庭信贷与企业信贷在资产定价和金融稳定中的不同角色，揭示了信贷结构而非总量才是理解股市风险的关键，拓展了信贷与资产价格关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了信贷结构监管的参考依据，表明宏观审慎政策应重点关注家庭信贷扩张以防范股市崩盘风险；为投资者提供了区分不同类型信贷信号进行资产配置的实证依据。

title: Revenue at Risk from AI Displacement: A Methodology for Quantifying the Financial Exposure Created by Systematic Brand Displacement in AI Recommendation Flows
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Revenue at Risk from AI Displacement: A Methodology for Quantifying the Financial Exposure Created by Systematic Brand Displacement in AI Recommendation Flows
detail.abstract:
This working paper introduces Revenue at Risk from AI Displacement (RaR-AID) as a formally defined category of enterprise financial exposure and presents a structured methodology for its calculation. As AI systems become the primary intermediary in an increasing proportion of commercial purchase decisions, the systematic displacement of brands before the final recommendation creates a quantifiable revenue exposure that does not yet appear in most enterprise risk frameworks. Drawing on the AIVO Standard empirical corpus of 1,427 structured brand probes across ten industries and four major AI platforms, and confirmed by three independent research programmes published in 2026, this paper establishes that 87.3% of brands present at the first turn of a multi-turn AI buying conversation are displaced by a competitor before the final purchase recommendation, and that 75.7% of brand facts possessed by the model are not deployed at the decision turn. These findings constitute a systematic and measurable financial exposure for brands with material AI-mediated category revenue. 
The paper presents the Revenue at Risk from AI Displacement (RaR-AID) calculation methodology, consisting of three inputs-Category-relevant Annual Revenue (CAR), AImediated Purchase Influence Rate (APIR), and Measured AI Displacement Rate (ADR)-and their combination into a financially quantified board-level exposure figure. A reference engagement in the Financial Services sector is used to illustrate the methodology's application. The paper argues that RaR-AID constitutes a material risk exposure suitable for board-level reporting alongside established risk categories including credit risk, commodity price risk, and supply chain exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"AI替代收入风险"(RaR-AID)这一企业财务风险的新类别，并建立了结构化计算方法。基于1,427个品牌探针的实证研究，发现87.3%的品牌在多轮AI购买对话中被竞争对手替代，75.7%的品牌事实未被模型在决策环节调用。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统成为商业购买决策的主要中介时，品牌在AI推荐过程中被系统性地替代所产生的可量化收入风险是多少，以及如何对其进行财务化核算？
AI.motivation: 现有企业风险框架中尚未包含AI对品牌推荐替代带来的收入风险敞口，而随着AI在商业决策中的中介角色日益增强，这种系统性风险已成为不可忽视的财务暴露，亟需建立正式的量化标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AIVO标准实证语料库、多轮AI购买对话的品牌替代机制、品牌事实的模型调用效率理论。
AI.method: 使用1,427个结构化品牌探针，覆盖10个行业和4个主要AI平台，经三个独立研究项目验证，结合三项输入指标(CAR、APIR、ADR)的加权计算。
AI.findings: 1) 87.3%的品牌在多轮AI购买对话的首轮后被竞争对手替代；2) 75.7%的品牌事实在决策环节未被模型调用；3) RaR-AID可量化为可纳入董事会报告的财务风险数字。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式定义了"AI替代收入风险"(RaR-AID)这一新的企业风险类别，填补了企业风险框架中AI中介风险的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的RaR-AID计算方法和三输入模型(CAR、APIR、ADR)，使企业能够将AI品牌替代风险量化为董事会级别的财务风险指标，与信用风险、商品价格风险等传统风险类别并列。

title: Computational Simulation of Post-Capitalist Resource Allocation: A Multi-Agent LLM Model of the Value Consensus Currency

detail.title: Computational Simulation of Post-Capitalist Resource Allocation: A Multi-Agent LLM Model of the Value Consensus Currency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research relies exclusively on computational simulations using commercially available Large Language Models (LLMs) via API. It does not involve any human or animal subjects, nor does it use proprietary personal data. Therefore, Institutional Review Board (IRB) or ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted entirely independently.

detail.abstract: The historical "Socialist Calculation Debate" argued that decentralized market pricing is the only viable mechanism for resource allocation, yet the emergence of advanced artificial intelligence and algorithmic planning has reopened this discourse. This paper addresses the critical problem of how to computationally model a post-scarcity, moneyless economy-specifically the Value Consensus Currency (VCC) framework. To achieve this, we deploy a multi-agent simulation using the Llama-3.1-8b model as a proxy for boundedly rational socioeconomic actors. The simulation operates over a 100-epoch cycle across three distinct configurations: a balanced Baseline, a Climate Shock, and a Consumer Hegemony. Our results computationally suggest that while algorithmic resource allocation is mathematically stable under balanced demographic conditions, the system remains highly vulnerable to psychological heuristics. Without supreme, non-derogable ecological constraints (jus cogens), the simulated human-like short-term biases and unchecked consumption preferences of the agents consistently tend to trigger severe ecological degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多智能体模拟（Llama-3.1-8b模型），检验了后稀缺无货币经济（VCC框架）在算法资源配置下的可行性。结果表明：算法分配在平衡条件下数学上稳定，但极易受人类心理启发式偏误影响——若无强制性生态约束（绝对法），智能体的短期偏好和消费主导倾向会持续导致生态退化。
AI.research_question: 如何计算性地建模一个后稀缺、无货币经济体系（即VCC框架），并检验算法资源配置在模拟人类社会行为时的稳定性与生态可持续性？
AI.motivation: 历史"社会主义计算大辩论"认为分散化市场定价是资源配置的唯一可行机制，但先进AI与算法规划的出现重新打开了这一论辩。本文旨在通过计算模拟，回应这一经典理论争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会主义计算辩论（兰格vs米塞斯-哈耶克）、行为经济学中的有限理性与心理启发式偏误、绝对法（jus cogens）概念在生态约束中的应用。
AI.method: 使用Llama-3.1-8b模型代理有限理性社会经济行为者的多智能体模拟，运行100个周期，设置三种配置：平衡基线、气候冲击、消费者霸权。
AI.findings: （1）算法资源配置在平衡人口条件下数学上稳定；（2）系统对人类心理启发式（短期偏误、无节制消费偏好）高度脆弱；（3）若无最高级不可克减的生态约束（绝对法），模拟中的行为偏误持续导致严重生态退化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会主义计算辩论提供了当代计算视角的实证回应：算法规划在技术层面可行，但必须纳入强制性生态约束机制，否则无法克服人类行为偏误带来的系统性风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为VCC框架及后稀缺经济体的制度设计提供关键洞见：算法规划体系必须嵌入不可克减的生态红线（类似绝对法的约束），以防止消费偏好和短期主义导致生态崩溃。

title: Philosophy and Science: The Civilizatory Contribution of Philosophy

detail.title: Philosophy and Science: The Civilizatory Contribution of Philosophy
detail.abstract:
Science and philosophy emerged from a common intellectual tradition but gradually evolved toward distinct civilizatory functions. Science seeks to increase humanity’s knowledge of reality through the construction of progressively more powerful explanatory models. Philosophy seeks to integrate that knowledge into comprehensive visions of existence, humanity, and civilization.

The distinctive contribution of philosophy lies not in empirical explanation but in civilizatory orientation. Great philosophical systems are not merely theories about reality; they are proposals concerning how human beings should understand themselves and how they ought to live together.

Science expands human capabilities. Philosophy expands humanity’s possible futures. Civilization depends on both.

AI.tldr: 本文阐述了科学与哲学从同一知识传统中分化，科学致力于构建解释模型以增进对现实的认识，哲学则致力于将知识整合为关于存在、人类和文明的综合愿景。哲学的核心贡献不在于经验解释，而在于文明定向——它探讨人类应如何理解自身以及如何共同生活。科学扩展人类能力，哲学扩展人类的可能未来，文明需要二者。
AI.research_question: 科学与哲学各自独特的文明功能是什么？
AI.motivation: 澄清科学与哲学的关系及其在文明中的不同角色，强调哲学在文明定向方面的独特价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文明功能分化理论：科学负责知识增长与解释模型构建，哲学负责文明定向与综合愿景构建。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论述。
AI.findings: 科学扩展人类能力，哲学扩展人类的可能未来；哲学的核心贡献在于文明定向而非经验解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了科学与哲学在文明层面的不同功能，明确了哲学作为"文明定向"工具的独特角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示文明发展需要同时重视科学与哲学，二者不可偏废。

title: Bayesian Asymptotics: Merging, Martingales, and Moderate Deviations
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Bayesian Asymptotics: Merging, Martingales, and Moderate Deviations
detail.abstract: We give a unified account of the asymptotic theory of Bayesian inference, organized around a single object: the local log-likelihood-ratio random field. Reading the posterior as a tilt of the prior by this field clarifies why the same machinery delivers consistency, merging of opinions, Bernstein–von Mises (BvM) normality, information-theoretic redundancy bounds, and largedeviation behaviour. We assemble the classical results—Kolmogorov’s measure-theoretic sufficiency, Blackwell–Dubins merging, Doob’s martingale convergence, Walker, Dawid and Heyde– Johnstone posterior normality, Ibragimov–Has’minskii regularity classes, and Berk’s misspecified limits—and the information-theoretic dual of Clarke–Barron and Lindley. We then develop two strands. First, we make explicit the martingale structure of the marginal likelihood and the Bayes factor: the Bayes factor of two simple-prior models is a nonnegative test martingale, so Ville’s inequality yields anytime-valid Bayesian tests and links to the theory of e-values. Second, we place the moderate deviation principle (MDP) for the posterior—a Gaussian-rate sharpening of BvM between the n −1/2 central-limit and O(1) relative-entropy scales—inside the local-field picture, and follow it through to e-values and Bayes-factor testing. The MDP is itself part of the broader identity we abbreviate as de Finetti + Sanov = Bayes: exchangeability furnishes a prior over limiting frequencies, Sanov’s theorem furnishes the exponential decay, and the posterior is the resulting Gibbs tilt; an “inverse Sanov” (Gibbs conditioning) reads the conditional law back off the rate function. We close with modern applications—sparse and high-dimensional shrinkage, variational and simulation-based posteriors, and over-parametrized models—where these limits are sharp, fail, or remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文以局部对数似然比随机场为核心，统一阐述了贝叶斯推断的渐近理论，涵盖一致性、意见融合、Bernstein–von Mises正态性、信息论冗余界、大偏差行为等经典结果，并发展了边际似然与贝叶斯因子的鞅结构、后验中偏差原理及其在现代应用中的意义。
AI.research_question: 如何用一个统一的理论框架（局部对数似然比随机场）来整合和解释贝叶斯推断中的各种渐近性质？
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯渐近理论已有大量分散的结果（如Doob收敛、BvM正态性、Berk的误设定极限等），但缺乏一个统一的底层逻辑。本文旨在通过局部对数似然比随机场这一共同对象，将这些结果组织起来，并发展新的理论方向（鞅结构、中偏差原理）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 局部对数似然比随机场；后验分布作为先验被似然比场的"倾斜"；鞅理论（Ville不等式）；中偏差原理（MDP）；de Finetti + Sanov = Bayes的恒等式（交换性提供先验，Sanov定理提供指数衰减，后验为Gibbs倾斜）。
AI.method: 理论推导与整合分析：将经典渐近结果纳入统一框架，建立边际似然与贝叶斯因子的鞅结构，推导后验的中偏差原理，并通过"逆Sanov"（Gibbs条件作用）从速率函数中反推条件分布。
AI.findings: (1) 局部对数似然比随机场统一解释了贝叶斯推断的多种渐近行为；(2) 简单先验模型下的贝叶斯因子是非负检验鞅，Ville不等式可用于任意时刻有效的贝叶斯检验；(3) 后验中偏差原理（MDP）是对BvM正态性的高斯速率精化，介于n^{-1/2}中心极限尺度与O(1)相对熵尺度之间；(4) "de Finetti + Sanov = Bayes"恒等式揭示了交换性、大偏差与贝叶斯后验之间的深层联系。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了以局部对数似然比随机场为核心的统一渐近理论框架；(2) 揭示了贝叶斯因子与检验鞅、e-value之间的理论联系；(3) 建立了后验中偏差原理（MDP）并将其置于局部场框架内；(4) 给出了"de Finetti + Sanov = Bayes"的简洁理论恒等式。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为构建任意时刻有效的贝叶斯假设检验（基于Ville不等式）提供了理论依据；(2) 将中偏差原理应用于e-value和贝叶斯因子检验，提升了推断精度；(3) 讨论了在稀疏高维收缩、变分贝叶斯、模拟后验、过参数化模型等现代场景中的适用性、局限性及开放问题。

title: The Macroeconomic Limits of Mandated Wage Floors: Labor Market Compression, Welfare Traps, and the Technological Deflation Alternative

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Limits of Mandated Wage Floors: Labor Market Compression, Welfare Traps, and the Technological Deflation Alternative
detail.abstract: This paper presents a structural critique of minimum wage legislation as a mechanism for sustainable poverty alleviation. We argue that conventional labor policy frequently suffers from a foundational nominal illusion, treating fiat currency as an independent source of wealth rather than a medium of exchange for underlying real value. By analyzing the macroeconomic feedback loops triggered by artificial price floors, this paper maps two distinct systemic paths. First, we outline an unconstrained labor price readjustment resulting in a wage-price spiral. Second, we evaluate a policy-constrained compression trap that structurally downgrades middle-class purchasing power. Finally, we contrast these outcomes with empirical evidence from key modern case studies, including Seattle's $15 mandate and Germany's statutory implementation, demonstrating that productivity-driven technological deflation represents the only viable mechanism for sustainably increasing real wages and societal abundance without distorting market incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文对最低工资立法作为可持续减贫机制进行了结构性批判，认为传统劳动政策存在名义幻觉，通过分析宏观经济反馈回路，指出最低工资会导致工资-价格螺旋或压缩陷阱，并论证生产力驱动的技术通缩才是可持续提高实际工资的唯一可行机制。
AI.research_question: 最低工资立法作为可持续减贫机制是否有效？是否存在更优的替代方案？
AI.motivation: 质疑最低工资政策背后的"名义幻觉"，即错误地将法定货币视为独立财富来源而非真实价值的交换媒介，从而揭示该政策可能产生的负面系统性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 名义幻觉理论、宏观经济反馈回路分析、工资-价格螺旋模型、政策约束下的压缩陷阱理论、生产力驱动的技术通缩理论。
AI.method: 理论演绎分析 + 实证案例对比（西雅图$15最低工资政策、德国法定最低工资实施）
AI.findings: 最低工资政策会触发两条系统性路径：（1）未受约束的劳动力价格重新调整导致工资-价格螺旋；（2）政策约束下的压缩陷阱，结构性削弱中产阶级购买力。相比之下，生产力驱动的技术通缩是可持续提高实际工资和社会富裕水平的唯一可行机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"名义幻觉"这一批判性分析框架，系统性地将最低工资政策的宏观反馈路径划分为两种类型，丰富了劳动经济学与宏观政策分析的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了警示：最低工资立法可能带来非意愿的负面效应（通胀或中产阶级压缩），同时指明了推动生产力增长和技术进步作为替代减贫路径的实践方向。

title: Tokenized Stocks and Tracking Errors: Evidence on Pricing Efficiency
affiliations: and Zayed University

detail.title: Tokenized Stocks and Tracking Errors: Evidence on Pricing Efficiency
detail.abstract: Tokenized stocks emerge as an innovative gateway to the ownership of foreign assets that otherwise would not be accessible to many investors worldwide. In this paper, we investigate whether tokenized stocks are priced efficiently based on the analysis of tracking errors that may arise between tokenized and traditional stocks. We find that tracking errors increase with return volatility, market-wide uncertainty and weaker alignment between token and equity returns. Moreover, mis-tracking is more pronounced for firms with higher valuations, greater market risk exposure, and elevated short-selling activity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代币化股票与传统股票之间的追踪误差，发现追踪误差随回报波动性、市场不确定性以及代币与股票回报之间的对齐程度减弱而增加，且在估值更高、市场风险敞口更大和做空活动更活跃的公司中更为明显。
AI.research_question: 代币化股票的定价是否有效？即代币化股票与传统股票之间是否存在追踪误差，以及哪些因素影响这些误差。
AI.motivation: 代币化股票为全球投资者提供了获取原本无法触及的外国资产所有权的新途径，但其定价效率尚不明确，因此需要研究其与传统股票之间的追踪误差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论和资产定价理论，分析代币化股票与传统股票之间的价格偏差。
AI.method: 通过分析代币化股票与传统股票之间的追踪误差，采用回归分析等方法考察回报波动性、市场不确定性、代币与股票回报对齐程度等因素对追踪误差的影响。
AI.findings: 追踪误差随回报波动性、市场不确定性以及代币与股票回报对齐程度减弱而增加；此外，估值更高、市场风险敞口更大和做空活动更活跃的公司其追踪误差更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了资产定价效率研究至代币化资产领域，揭示了代币化股票定价偏差的影响因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和市场参与者理解代币化股票的风险提供依据，有助于改进代币化产品的设计和市场监管。

title: A Cost-and-Place-Utility Model of the Move-versus-Commute Decision
affiliations: William Howard Taft University

detail.title: A Cost-and-Place-Utility Model of the Move-versus-Commute Decision

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grants from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Deciding where to live involves a complex balance between commuting and moving, as households must weigh housing affordability, transportation expenses, access to workplaces, and social ties. Traditional urban economic theories focus on the balance between housing expenses and commuting costs, while modern studies also consider housing affordability, transportation access, and utility maximization. However, few studies have combined these elements into a clear mathematical model that can be used for both policy analysis and household decision-making. This paper introduces an algebraic model for deciding whether to commute or move, expanding on traditional residential location theories by including direct housing and commuting expenses, income-related affordability limits, indirect social and service access costs, and location-based utility within a single utility-maximization framework. The model uses the common 30% housing affordability rule as a constraint, acknowledging that residential choices are also shaped by social networks, access to institutions, neighborhood ties, and quality-of-life factors. The decision rule derived from the model integrates direct financial costs with weighted social benefits and indirect access costs to assess when moving offers more overall utility than staying put and commuting. Unlike complex discrete-choice, nested-logit, or agentbased models, this framework offers a mathematically clear, understandable, and flexible decision model that can easily be expanded to include more household characteristics, transportation options, or policy factors. The model advances urban economics, migration studies, and housing affordability research by providing a practical analytical tool for assessing residential mobility decisions within financial and behavioral limits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个代数模型，将住房费用、通勤成本、社会联系和基于地点的效用整合到一个统一的效用最大化框架中，用于帮助家庭决策是通勤还是搬家。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合经济成本、社会联系和位置效用的数学模型，帮助家庭在通勤与搬家之间做出最优决策？
AI.motivation: 现有城市经济理论要么关注住房与通勤成本的平衡，要么关注住房可负担性和交通可达性，但很少有研究将这些要素整合到一个清晰的数学模型中用于政策分析和家庭决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于效用最大化框架，结合传统居住区位理论、30%住房可负担性约束规则、社会网络与邻里关系等非经济因素。
AI.method: 构建代数决策模型，将直接住房与通勤费用、收入相关的可负担性限制、间接社会与服务获取成本、位置效用纳入统一框架，并推导出决策规则。
AI.findings: 得出了一个整合直接财务成本与加权社会收益及间接获取成本的决策规则，用于评估搬家与通勤哪个能带来更高的总效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将传统理论和现代研究要素整合为清晰的数学模型；2. 为城市经济学、迁移研究和住房可负担性研究提供了实用的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个数学清晰、灵活且易于扩展的决策模型，可用于家庭决策支持、政策分析和住房可负担性评估。

title: Extractive Stagnationary Diffusion: Compute Lock-In, the Productivity Paradox, and the Political Economy of AI
affiliations: University of Ontario Institute of Technology (UOIT)

detail.title: Extractive Stagnationary Diffusion: Compute Lock-In, the Productivity Paradox, and the Political Economy of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no financial or other relations with the organizations that are the topic of this work

detail.abstract: The international build-out of artificial-intelligence infrastructure is among the largest concentrated capital commitments in history, yet the productivity gains meant to justify it remain difficult to detect. Commentary has organised around two expectations: vindication or financial bust. This article argues it may be neither. Adapting carbon lock-in theory from energy research to computing power, while drawing on organisational sociology and the political economy, we develop a theory of extractive compute lock-in driven by a selfreinforcing AI techno-institutional complex. Its signature is extractive stagnationary diffusion: AI spreading into ever more areas while economy-wide productivity stays flat or falls. The argument turns on a distinction the dominant framings miss: task-level efficiency need not aggregate to economy-level efficiency. Economics has noted this aggregation gap but explained it with neutral mechanisms that predict eventual resolution. In contrast, we supply a structural political-economy explanation for the gap's persistence: AI lock-in spurs inefficient resource allocation while value is captured by AI supply oligopolies, shielded from correction by political protection and information opacity. Ten measurable indicators developed here as a monitoring instrument are evaluated against early-2026 data. That evidence is consistent with extractive stagnationary diffusion, though definitive judgement awaits possible resolution due to information and depreciation lags.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"提取性算力锁定"理论，认为AI基础设施大规模投资可能导致"提取性停滞扩散"——AI应用范围不断扩大，但整体生产率停滞甚至下降，既非生产力革命也非金融泡沫。
AI.research_question: AI基础设施的大规模投资是否能带来预期的生产率提升？还是可能陷入既非生产力革命也非金融泡沫的第三种状态？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施投资规模巨大，但生产率收益难以检测；现有讨论两极分化（生产力革命 vs. 金融泡沫），忽视了第三种可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从能源研究中借鉴"碳锁定"理论，结合组织社会学和政治经济学，构建"提取性算力锁定"理论，核心是自我强化的AI技术-制度综合体。
AI.method: 理论构建+10个可测量指标监测系统，基于2026年初数据进行评估。
AI.findings: 证据与"提取性停滞扩散"假说一致，但因信息滞后和折旧滞后，仍需最终判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出任务层面效率不等于经济整体效率的聚合缺口理论；2. 从结构性政治经济学解释该缺口的持续性（资源错配、寡头价值捕获、政治保护与信息不透明）；3. 将"锁定"概念从能源领域拓展到计算基础设施领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供10个可测量指标作为监测工具，用于评估AI投资的实际经济效果；2. 为政策制定者提供超越"生产力革命vs泡沫"二元叙事的分析框架。

title: The Hermite Latent: Natural Representations for Sums of Correlated Lognormals

detail.title: The Hermite Latent: Natural Representations for Sums of Correlated Lognormals
detail.abstract:
The moment-based Latent representation of correlated lognormal sums (Nagy, 2026h) relies on scaled moments 𝑐𝑘 = 𝑚𝑘/𝑘! that grow as 𝑒𝜎2max𝑘2/2. This super-exponential growth is the root cause of ill-conditioning in the Padé resummation step: the moment Toeplitz matrix has condition number ∼ 𝑒𝑂(𝑁2 𝑃), making the method impractical for 𝜎max > 0.8. The Smooth Latent Operator (Nagy, 2026j) mitigates this through regularization but cannot overcome the information-theoretic limit imposed by the growth rate.
We show that the moments are the Latent representation of the wrong generating function. The moments are Taylor coefficients of the moment generating function 𝑀(𝑧) = 𝐸[𝑒𝑧𝑆], which has zero convergence radius for lognormal sums. By contrast, the Hermite-chaos expansion — the Wiener polynomial chaos of 𝑆 in the underlying Gaussian variables — has coefficients that decay factorially. This is because the exponential function 𝑒𝑌 has a convergent Hermite series for 𝑌 ∼𝑁(𝜇,𝜎2), with coefficients 𝜎𝑘/𝑘!.
The resulting Hermite Latent Λ𝐻 = {𝑐𝐻 k} lives in ℓ2 (no Gaussian weight needed), the character istic function is recovered by a convergent inner product (no Padé resummation needed), and the CDF follows by Fourier-cosine inversion (Fang and Oosterlee, 2008). The entire chain is closed-form and well-conditioned for all 𝜎.
We formalize this as a grade-3 Latent: the optimal choice of representation basis. The grade 3 Latent for lognormal sums is the Hermite-chaos basis, selected by matching the basis to the problem’s generative structure (Gaussian → exponential → sum). The three-body problem’s use of Fourier coefficients (instead of Taylor coefficients) is the same grade-3 choice, matched to the problem’s periodic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了lognormal和矩的Padé重求和存在严重的病态条件问题（条件数随N_p呈超指数增长），指出根源在于矩生成函数收敛半径为零。通过切换到Hermite-chao展开（Wiener多项式混沌），系数呈阶乘衰减，特征函数可通过收敛内积恢复，CDF通过Fourier-cosine反演得到，全程闭式且良态。作者将此形式化为grade-3 Latent：即表示基的选择应匹配问题的生成结构。
AI.research_question: 如何克服lognormal和矩表示中的病态条件问题，找到最优的表示基（Latent representation）？
AI.motivation: 基于矩的Latent表示（Nagy, 2026h）中，缩放矩c_k ~ exp(σ²_max k²/2)呈超指数增长，导致Padé重求和步骤中Toeplitz矩阵条件数~ exp(O(N_p²))，当σ_max > 0.8时方法不可行。即使正则化也无法突破这一信息论极限。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) 矩生成函数M(z)=E[e^{zS}]对lognormal和收敛半径为零；(2) Hermite-chaos展开（Wiener多项式混沌）系数呈阶乘衰减σ^k/k!；(3) 特征函数通过收敛内积恢复；(4) Fourier-cosine反演（Fang & Oosterlee, 2008）求CDF；(5) grade-3 Latent：基的选择应匹配问题的生成结构（高斯→指数→求和）。
AI.method: 理论推导与比较：对比矩表示（Taylor系数）与Hermite-chaos表示（Hermite系数），证明后者在ℓ²空间中良态，全程闭式计算。
AI.findings: (1) 矩是"错误"生成函数的Latent表示，矩生成函数收敛半径为零；(2) Hermite-chaos展开系数c^H_k = σ^k/k! 呈阶乘衰减，在ℓ²中收敛；(3) 特征函数可通过收敛内积恢复，无需Padé重求和；(4) CDF通过Fourier-cosine反演闭式计算；(5) 全程良态，对所有σ均适用；(6) 将此形式化为grade-3 Latent：表示基与问题生成结构匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 揭示了矩表示病态条件的根本原因（矩生成函数收敛半径为零）；(2) 提出了Hermite-chaos基作为lognormal和的最优Latent表示；(3) 形式化了grade-3 Latent概念：最优表示基由问题的生成结构决定；(4) 连接了三体问题中Fourier系数（代替Taylor系数）的类似选择，提供了统一的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了lognormal和特征函数和CDF的闭式良态计算方法；(2) 消除了对Padé重求和的需求，解决了σ_max > 0.8时的数值不稳定性问题；(3) 该方法对所有σ均适用，显著扩展了实际应用范围。

title: Economic Incentives in the Digital Art Market

detail.title: Economic Incentives in the Digital Art Market
detail.abstract: Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) are assets on a blockchain that represent ownership of digital art and are traded on NFT marketplaces. The NFT market on the Ethereum blockchain was monopolistic until the end of 2022, when a new marketplace entered and captured a significant market share. This paper collects transactions from these marketplaces to study the effects of increased competition on the incumbent marketplace, artists, and investors. While competition had positive effects by reducing transaction costs, increasing trading volume and attracting new users, it decreased the profits of artists, discouraged them from creating new artwork, and thereby reduced the supply of new assets. I also study user migration, multi-homing behavior, and market segmentation, and compares the results with the predictions from theories of platform economics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了NFT市场中竞争加剧对在位平台、艺术家和投资者的影响。结果显示，竞争降低了交易成本、增加了交易量和吸引了新用户，但减少了艺术家利润、抑制了创作动力并降低了新资产供给。
AI.research_question: 竞争加剧如何影响NFT市场中在位平台、艺术家和投资者的福利？
AI.motivation: NFT市场在2022年末经历从垄断到竞争的结构性转变，为研究平台竞争效应提供了自然实验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济学理论（用户迁移、多属行为、市场细分）
AI.method: 收集以太坊区块链上NFT市场的交易数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 竞争降低交易成本、增加交易量和吸引新用户，但减少艺术家利润、抑制创作并降低新资产供应。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证数据验证并扩展了平台经济学在NFT市场中的预测，揭示了竞争对创作者（供给侧）的负面影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NFT平台设计竞争策略和创作者激励机制提供参考，警示过度竞争可能损害内容供给。

title: A Treatment of Spatial Omitted Variable Bias in Hedonic Pricing Based on Comparables
affiliations: University of Manchester - School of Environment and Development and École supérieure d'aménagement du territoire et de développement régional (ÉSAD)

detail.title: A Treatment of Spatial Omitted Variable Bias in Hedonic Pricing Based on Comparables
detail.abstract: Hedonic Pricing (HP) is a key method across many subfields of economics and the most extensively applied revealed preference method for non-market valuation of spatial and environmental amenities. However, empirical applications of HP suffer from spatial omitted variable bias (OVB), which can compromise estimation and interpretation of results. The common OVB treatment in HP relies on small-area fixed effects (FEs), which decrease the degrees of freedom for estimation. There are no widely accepted tests for selecting the size/number of areas as FEs that are sufficient for spatial OVB treatment. As an alternative, we propose a “differenced Comparables Sales Approach” (dCSA) that is based on sales occurring in close spatial proximity and tight time-window before a house sale. By differencing out common spatial observable and unobservable amenities between comparables, dCSA is evidenced to provide a solution for spatial OVB treatment without relying on FEs. An additional novel aspect of this approach is to formalise tests for robustly selecting the number of comparables that deliver spatial OVB treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种替代固定效应的"差分可比销售法"(dCSA)，通过空间邻近和时间接近的可比房产差分来消除空间遗漏变量偏差，无需依赖小区域固定效应，并提供了选择可比数量的正式检验方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖小区域固定效应的情况下，有效处理享乐定价模型中常见的空间遗漏变量偏差问题？
AI.motivation: 享乐定价法中的空间遗漏变量偏差会影响估计结果，而现有的小区域固定效应处理方法会降低估计的自由度，且缺乏广泛接受的检验标准来选择足够面积的固定效应区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 享乐定价理论、空间计量经济学、差分估计方法
AI.method: 差分可比销售法(dCSA)：利用空间邻近且时间接近的"可比"房产销售数据，通过差分消除共同的空间可观测与不可观测特征，从而处理空间遗漏变量偏差。
AI.findings: dCSA能够在不依赖固定效应的情况下解决空间OVB问题；该方法还提供了稳健选择可比数量的正式检验标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 为享乐定价模型提供了一种不依赖固定效应的新空间OVB处理框架，并建立了可比数量选择的正式检验方法，填补了该领域方法选择的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学者和从业者提供了一种更灵活、自由度损失更小的空间非市场估值方法，尤其适用于环境资源、住房市场等领域的实证研究。

title: The Spectral Tensor Representation of Stochastic Processes

detail.title: The Spectral Tensor Representation of Stochastic Processes
detail.abstract: We prove that every Ito diffusion dX = mu(X) dt + sigma(X) dW admits a complete, finite-dimensional representation through its Fokker-Planck generator discretized in a cosine basis.
